name: David Malmström
headline: Senior Frontend Engineer
summary: I’m a senior frontend engineer with a background in design. I build and modernize web applications across ecommerce, finance, and charity, often contributing to DevOps and UX alongside frontend development. I enjoy improving how teams work and collaborating in agile teams.

labels.educationNote: Studies in computer science; degree not completed.

devcore.title: IT Consultant
devcore.description: I lead and contribute to client projects, combining frontend development with UX, DevOps, and collaboration across disciplines.

assignments.title: Front End Lead
highlights: Led the Vue 2 to Vue 3 migration across an enterprise ecommerce application’s product listings, product pages, and checkout.
Integrated multiple payment gateways and enabled ERP-specific configuration.
Established communication between vanilla JavaScript and Vue, with shared JavaScript API methods.
Introduced Vitest unit and component testing, and adopted TypeScript incrementally to catch errors in new and legacy code and make frontend behavior more predictable.

assignments.title: Software Developer
assignments.description: Built a React donation application with BankID integration, using TanStack Query for server state and Zustand for client state.

assignments.title: Software Developer
highlights: Led successive Angular upgrades from version 8 to 14 for private wealth management applications.
Structured an Nx workspace with separate libraries, components, and services.
Built a type-safe translation system with autocomplete for translation keys.
Collaborated across teams and closely with the design system team in a cross-functional environment.
Took ownership of a life insurance and pension application from another team and rebuilt it, expanding beyond private wealth management.

rightGrafiska.title: Graphic Designer
rightGrafiska.description: Substitute graphic designer, creating work for print and digital channels, including magazines, brochures, business cards, websites, newsletters, stickers, and advertising.

freelance.title: Graphic Designer
freelance.description: Created logos, brand identities, and websites for clients.

education.details: Studies toward a bachelor's degree; not completed.

recommendation.quote: I can really recommend David if you are looking for someone who is dedicated, is curious to find new interesting ways forward and not least feels professional pride in what he delivers.
recommendation.author: Daniel Blomgren

personal.interests: Outside work, I enjoy yoga, meditation, indie video games, roleplaying games, and cooking.
